Markets.title: US stocks: Nasdaq reports network disruption, US equities data feeds impacted
Markets.summary: Nasdaq experienced a network disruption at its Carteret facility that caused data gaps in US equities markets. The exchange advised clients to switch to backup feeds from Chicago and submit recovery requests for missing information.

Markets.title: S&P 500’s road to 8,000 grows tougher as yields rise, AI doubts mount; all eyes on quarterly earnings
Markets.summary: Analysts are skeptical that the S&P 500 will reach 8,000 points because rising oil prices, bond yields, and midterm election uncertainty are increasing market risk. Additionally, mixed financial results from major tech companies and a growing performance gap between large and small corporations are raising doubts about equity investments.

Markets.title: Sebi writes to IRDAI to include investors' insurance policy details in consolidated account statement
Markets.summary: SEBI has asked the IRDAI to include investors' insurance policy details in the Consolidated Account Statement to provide a comprehensive financial overview. Efforts are also underway with RBI support to integrate bank deposits into this reporting framework.

Markets.title: IIFL Finance Q2 profit nearly doubles to Rs 805 crore; AUM rises 38%
Markets.summary: IIFL Finance's quarterly profit nearly doubled to Rs 805 crore due to stronger operating leverage and reduced loan losses. The company's assets under management grew 38% to Rs 1.24 lakh crore, driven primarily by gold loans.

Markets.title: L&T Finance Q2 net profit rises 33% to Rs 975 crore
Markets.summary: L&T Finance reported a 33% increase in consolidated net profit to Rs 975 crore for the quarter ending September 30, 2026. During the same period, the company's consolidated loan book grew 28% to Rs 1.36 lakh crore while asset quality improved.

Markets.title: Sebi revises CAS rules, changes derivatives expiry settlement methodology
Markets.summary: Sebi announced that the equity cash market closing auction session will run from 3:30 pm to 3:40 pm starting in December 2026. The regulator also updated the methodology for calculating derivatives contract settlement prices and established new transition rules for unexecuted orders.

Geo-Political.title: Trump calls off livestream of Fort Hood attacker's execution by firing squad
Geo-Political.summary: President Trump canceled the planned livestream of Nidal Hasan's execution by firing squad. Hasan is scheduled to be the first military service member executed in over 60 years.

Geo-Political.title: Houthi missile attack on Yemeni presidential palace kills two, minister says
Geo-Political.summary: Ballistic missiles fired by Houthi forces struck al-Maashiq Palace in Yemen, killing two people. Yemen's information minister stated that the prime minister and other ministers inside the presidential palace were unhurt.

Geo-Political.title: Russia accuses Ukraine of attacking oil refinery after Zelensky says strikes to resume
Geo-Political.summary: Russia accused Ukraine of launching a drone attack on an oil refinery. The strike occurred after Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy announced that his country would resume targeting Russian energy sites following fresh attacks.

Geo-Political.title: At least 33 pupils and teacher killed after school roof collapses in Pakistan
Geo-Political.summary: A school roof collapsed across three classrooms in Pakistan, killing at least 33 pupils and a teacher. Children were left buried beneath the debris following the structural failure.

Geo-Political.title: Maduro pleads not guilty to new torture-related charges in New York
Geo-Political.summary: Venezuelan leader Nicolás Maduro pleaded not guilty in a New York court to newly added charges related to torture. Maduro rejected the legal documents entirely during his court appearance.

Geo-Political.title: Was Neanderthal life violent? This wound suggests lethal fighting was more common
Geo-Political.summary: A 75,000-year-old Neanderthal spear wound suggests that lethal interpersonal violence occurred much earlier in human history than previously believed. This finding indicates that violent conflict significantly shaped early human life.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: The author discovered their WordPress SaaS course was recommended as the top result when asking ChatGPT for the best course in that category. This unexpected AI recommendation occurred without any paid advertising or traditional search engine optimization.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Tools That Will Transform Your Content Creation in 2025
AI & Tech.summary: This article outlines ten essential artificial intelligence tools designed to help creators improve their digital content production in 2025. It explains how these technologies are modernizing workflows and making content creation easier for digital creators.

AI & Tech.title: LimeWire AI Studio Review 2023: Details, Pricing & Features
AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire has transitioned into a generative AI platform that allows users to create digital content. The tool also provides features for creators to share and monetize their AI-generated work.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Tools in 2023 That Will Make Your Life Easier
AI & Tech.summary: This article explores the top ten artificial intelligence tools of 2023 that automate tasks and improve workplace efficiency. These advanced, widely used applications are designed to enhance productivity across various industries.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Content Generator & Writer Tools in 2022
AI & Tech.summary: This article explores the growing market of AI content generator and writer tools in 2022. It aims to help readers choose the right software to create engaging and efficient content for their audiences.

AI & Tech.title: Beginner Guide to CJ Affiliate (Commission Junction) in 2022
AI & Tech.summary: This guide explains how beginners can use the CJ Affiliate network to earn money. It also highlights top CJ affiliate programs and alternative platforms for monetization.

Data & Insights.title: India may hike fuel prices in November, pushing inflation above RBI target: Oxford Economist
Data & Insights.summary: Oxford Economics reports that India may moderately increase fuel prices in November before upcoming state elections. This potential price hike is expected to push inflation above the Reserve Bank of India's target.

Data & Insights.title: Put private sector at center of development agenda: Sitharaman to World Bank
Data & Insights.summary: Indian Finance Minister Sitharaman urged the World Bank to place the private sector at the center of its development agenda to prioritize job creation and productivity. She also called on the multilateral lender to provide competitive pricing and local currency financing tools.

Data & Insights.title: RBI’s new forex reserve rules explained: FAQs on the 20% requirement, $2 million threshold and exemptions
Data & Insights.summary: The Reserve Bank of India has clarified its 20% foreign exchange risk reserve requirement for rupee-linked currency derivatives. The new guidance details specific application rules, including a $2 million threshold, exemptions, cancellations, and rollovers.

Data & Insights.title: US wholesale inflation hits four-year high of 6.3% in September as gas prices surge
Data & Insights.summary: US wholesale inflation rose to a four-year high of 6.3% in September. This acceleration was primarily driven by a sharp increase in gas prices that raised producer costs.

Data & Insights.title: Unemployment rate rises in urban areas in September
Data & Insights.summary: Urban unemployment increased in September. However, steady rural joblessness kept the overall national unemployment rate stable.

Data & Insights.title: Net direct tax collections up 13.2% at  ₹13.38 tn, corporate tax buoys
Data & Insights.summary: Net direct tax collections in India rose 13.2% to ₹13.38 trillion. This growth was primarily driven by strong corporate tax revenues.

India.title: "Rahul Gandhi Thinks Mobocracy Is The Way": Smriti Irani To NDTV
India.summary: Smriti Irani accused Rahul Gandhi of promoting "mobocracy" because he constantly attacks the Election Commission of India. She defended the Election Commission as the institution that ensures a vibrant democracy in the country.

India.title: "His Own Empire": VD Satheesan On Pinarayi Vijayan's Infra Board Irregularities
India.summary: Kerala opposition leader VD Satheesan criticized Chief Minister Pinarayi Vijayan after a report revealed major irregularities within the Kerala Infrastructure Investment Fund Board (KIIFB). The report stated that KIIFB illegally expanded its staff, spent ₹203.72 crore on publicity in one year, and approved its own borrowing guarantees.

India.title: VFS Global To Open First Visa Application Centre In Guwahati
India.summary: VFS Global is opening its first visa application centre in Guwahati to serve applicants from eight northeastern states. The new facility offers strong air, rail, and road connectivity to improve regional access to visa services.

India.title: B****y S**t: IAS Officer Abuses Woman Colleague In Virtual Meeting In J&K
India.summary: Jammu and Kashmir IAS officer Kumar Rajeev Ranjan verbally abused a female colleague using profanity during a virtual official meeting. Ranjan serves as the Secretary of the Labour and Employment Department.

India.title: Wife Of Medical Shop Owner Who Shot Punjab Anti-Drug Activist Arrested
India.summary: Police arrested the wife of a medical shop owner in connection with the shooting of a Punjab anti-drug activist. Authorities also placed the alleged shooter, Ashwani Kumar, and his associate in a seven-day police remand.

India.title: Actor Imran Khan To Challenge 'Leave India' Order In Bombay High Court
India.summary: Actor Imran Khan will file a petition in the Bombay High Court to challenge a government order to leave India. His lawyer, Zulfiqar Memon, is handling the legal challenge.

General.title: Former DUP leader Donaldson sentenced to 15 years in prison for child sex abuse
General.summary: Former DUP leader Jeffrey Donaldson was sentenced to 15 years in prison after being convicted of 18 counts of child sex abuse, including rape. The crimes were committed against two victims when they were children.

General.title: Trump calls off livestream of Fort Hood attacker's execution by firing squad
General.summary: Former President Trump canceled the planned livestream of the execution of Nidal Hasan, the Fort Hood shooter. Hasan is scheduled to face the first military execution in over 60 years.

General.title: Trans people should use hospital spaces according to biological sex, NHS England says
General.summary: NHS England has issued new guidance stating that transgender patients should be treated in single-sex hospital wards or bays that match their biological sex. This policy affects how hospitals accommodate trans individuals during their medical care.

General.title: Russell Brand accuser says he turned 'monster-like' before alleged rape
General.summary: An accuser of Russell Brand stated that he became like a monster prior to an alleged rape. Brand currently faces three counts of rape, three charges of sexual assault, and one charge of indecent assault.

General.title: Banks say Healey is planning Budget tax raid on their profits
General.summary: Senior banking executives expect Chancellor Rachel Healey to target bank profits with new taxes in the upcoming Budget. Bank leaders shared these concerns with the BBC ahead of the policy announcement later this month.

General.title: This 75,000-year-old wound suggests Neanderthal life was more violent than we thought
General.summary: A 75,000-year-old Neanderthal skeleton features a spear wound that indicates interpersonal violence. This evidence suggests that violence has shaped human life much earlier than previously believed.
